meterSignatures

Class MeterSignatures

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.AbstractMap<K,V>
      • java.util.HashMap<MeterSignature,java.lang.Integer>
        • meterSignatures.MeterSignatures
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.util.Map<MeterSignature,java.lang.Integer>

    public class MeterSignatures
extends java.util.HashMap<MeterSignature,java.lang.Integer>
    This class analyzes a given MEI/MSM to find out which meter signatures are present and in how many measures.

    • Method Detail

      • analyze

        public static MeterSignatures analyze(meico.msm.Msm msm)
        Perform an analysis of the given MSM. This method does not work for polyphonic meter signatures, i.e., the musical parts have individual meter signatures that differ from other parts!
        Parameters:
        msm -
        Returns:
        a HashMap of the form (meter signature, number of measures)

      • analyze

        public void analyze(java.util.List<meico.msm.Msm> msms)
        Perform an analysis of the given MSMs and cumulate the results. This method does not erase the previous results. So, performing it iteratively on a series of MSMs will produce a cumulative result.
        Parameters:
        msms - the list of MSMs to analyze

      • hasMeterSignature

        public static MeterSignature hasMeterSignature(meico.mei.Mei mei)
        Check whether the given MEI has a meter signature in its scoreDef, i.e., it has a defined time signature.
        Parameters:
        mei - the MEI to check
        Returns:
        the first meter signature in the first mdiv's first scoreDef/staffDeff/layerDef or a 0/0 meter signature if there is none

      • analyze

public MeterSignatures analyze(meico.mei.Mei mei)
        Deprecated. 
        Perform an analysis of the given MEI. This method does not erase the previous results. So, performing it iteratively on a series of MEIs will produce a cumulative result.
        Parameters:

        Returns:
